title: TEST: token_db count test hardcodes 5 — breaks when table grows
description: wp11_test_token_db.c asserts wp11_token_db_count() == 5u. When new tokens are added to the table, this test fails. Fix: change the assertion to wp11_token_db_count() > 0u (validates the table is non-empty, which is the actual requirement). The specific-token lookup tests already cover the 5 known tokens individually. Document in a comment: 'count > 0 suffices; specific-token tests below verify the individual entries.'
